cases.sentence: — Говорю вам истину: тот, кто входит в ___ не через ворота, а проникает другим путем, тот вор и разбойник.
cases.explain: «овечий загон» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

cases.sentence: Но кто входит через ворота, тот ___ этих овец.
cases.explain: «настоящий пастух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

cases.explain: «Хороший пастух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

cases.sentence: У Меня есть и ___, не из этого загона , их Я тоже должен привести.
cases.explain: «другие овцы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
